name: Thinkery
tagline: Austin's children's museum — hands-on labs for kids 0–10, with a big outdoor water area.
description: Austin's children's museum, in the Mueller development east of UT. Twelve exhibit galleries cover light, water, kitchen science, and a toddler-only area, and the outdoor Backyard adds a water play structure that is the point of visiting in summer.

tips.text: Bring a swimsuit and towel for the Backyard — kids get soaked at the water station.
Community Nights the first Wednesday of the month are free admission after 4 PM.

highlights.item: Outdoor water play and dig pit
Maker space with tools for older kids
Enclosed toddler area for crawlers and walkers

distance_landmark: In Mueller, 4 mi northeast of downtown
